headword: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}

definitions.explanation: A promotional offer allowing users to try a product or service for free for a limited time before committing to a paid subscription.

examples.japanese: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧。
examples.english: I signed up for the free trial.

examples.japanese: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1ヶ{月|げつ}です。
examples.english: The free trial is for one month.

examples.japanese: {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{課金|かきん}される→課金する：23205_kakinsuru⟧。
examples.english: You'll be automatically charged when the free trial period ends.

notes:
{無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん} is commonly offered by subscription services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}む→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧ (to sign up for a free trial)
- {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (free trial period)
- {無料|むりょう}{体験|たいけん}⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧ (free trial campaign)

WATCH OUT:
- Many free trials require credit card registration.
- Auto-renewal (⟦{自動|じどう}{更新|こうしん}→自動更新：09742_jidoukoushin⟧) is often enabled by default.
